name: Can I convert my existing bathtub into a walk-in shower?

mainEntity.name: Can I convert my existing bathtub into a walk-in shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting an old bathtub into a walk-in shower is one of the most common bathroom remodeling projects. The process involves removing the existing tub, evaluating the underlying plumbing and subfloor, relocating the drain if necessary, and installing a new waterproof shower pan, wall surround, and fixtures. A major decision factor is plumbing placement; tub drains are typically 1.5 inches, whereas shower drains require a 2-inch pipe to handle water flow properly. While you gain easier accessibility, open space, and a modern aesthetic, the tradeoff is losing a soaking basin, which can be an important consideration for households with small children.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, converting a tub into a walk-in shower is common and involves removing the tub, updating the drain size, installing waterproofing, and adding tile or wall surrounds.
